scene: Episode 02 · Scene 04 — INT. COLD CARRIAGE — CONTINUOUS — THE FROST GROWS OUTWARD
shot: v5 = v4 (aperture plane, Kell's pale coat, Tomas large) with the v4 fault fixed: the Sc03 corpse frame now owns his face/coat/seat only, and a matched ALIVE plate owns Shot 2. He is alive and writing while frost grows out of him.
prompt:
Live-action mythic modernism. Photoreal, tactile, cinematic, anamorphic widescreen, 24fps, shallow depth of field. FOUR SHOTS, cut in camera at the stated times, and no other coverage. All spoken dialogue is in ENGLISH.

CAMERA DOCTRINE: SHOTS 1, 3 AND 4 EACH CARRY ONE slow, smooth, continuous, dead-steady MECHANICAL PUSH IN at a constant speed, beginning on the first frame and STILL MOVING WHEN THE SHOT CUTS — never accelerating, never easing, never stopping. NOT handheld: no shake, no wobble, no jitter. In each of those a named object sits CLOSE TO THE LENS and OUT OF FOCUS at one edge and slides faster than the background, giving parallax.
SHOT 2 IS ABSOLUTELY LOCKED AND UNCUT and that is the point of the film — nothing may be suspected of hiding what happens inside it.

REFERENCE PRECEDENCE — EACH IMAGE OWNS ONLY WHAT IS NAMED HERE:
@Image1 IS A FRAME FROM THE PRECEDING SCENE. It is the authority for KELL'S FACE, HAIR, COAT AND SEAT and for THIS CARRIAGE. IT IS NOT THE AUTHORITY FOR HIS CONDITION: it shows him dead and frozen, which is correct for the room in Shots 1, 3 and 4 and WRONG for the picture inside the oval in Shot 2.
@Image2 IS THE ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY FOR WHAT IS SEEN INSIDE THE OVAL IN SHOT 2: the same man in the same coat at the same table — ALIVE, eyes open, writing with a pen, lit cold and flat from above.
@Image3 is a secondary reference for the carriage.
@Image9 is a reference for the EVIDENCE PLANE's colour and matte chalky surface only.

KELL, EVERYWHERE IN THIS FILM: a clean-shaven man in his fifties with GREY HAIR, in a HEAVY PALE GREY-OATMEAL WOOL OVERCOAT with wide notched lapels. HIS COAT IS PALE GREY — NOT black, NOT dark brown, NOT navy. He sits at his RIGHT-HAND WINDOW TABLE with a white tablecloth, an amber pleated table lamp beside him and a clear dry window onto a flat white frozen lake. The carriage around him is warm walnut panelling with amber lamps and occupied tables.

THE EVIDENCE PLANE IS AN APERTURE. THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION ABOUT IT:
It is a standing OVAL about forty-five centimetres tall, held upright in the air. ITS EDGE IS A HARD SATURATED MATTE RED RIM about two centimetres wide — chalky, zero gloss, and it NEVER GLOWS and emits no light at all.
EVERYTHING INSIDE THAT RIM IS A DIFFERENT PICTURE. YOU SEE THROUGH THE OVAL, as through a hole cut in the air, into another moment. It is NOT a solid disc, NOT a paddle, NOT a plate, NOT a screen, NOT a mirror and NOT a coloured filter. It is a HOLE IN THE AIR WITH A RED EDGE.
THE RED NEVER SPREADS BEYOND THAT RIM. OUTSIDE THE OVAL THE CARRIAGE IS COMPLETELY UNAFFECTED WARM WALNUT AND AMBER LAMPLIGHT. INSIDE THE OVAL THE IMAGE IS COLD, FLAT AND BLUE-WHITE — the light of an overcast pier at 6500K, falling from above. Every frame containing the oval carries TWO LIGHTING STATES SIDE BY SIDE THAT NEVER BLEND, with one hard red line between them.

FROST GROWS OUTWARD FROM BODIES AND NEVER INWARD FROM ANYTHING: it starts on a person's skin or clothes and its fine needles spread AWAY from them. The stone, the windows and the air never frost. In this film the only frost is on Kell and on the cloth and table immediately around him. The windows are CLEAR AND DRY.

CAST:
@Image6 and @Image7 are BEATRICE MORD — a WOMAN in her early forties, dark hair in a TIGHT HIGH TOPKNOT, clean-shaven, in a BLACK ASYMMETRICAL WRAP COAT wrapped and belted across the body over a full-length OXBLOOD-AND-RUST underskirt panel. She has NO cream panel, NO tall collar, NO cuffs, NO ribbon, NO blue, NO rust sash, NO leather chest strap, NO glass cylinders, NO earrings and NO veil.
@Image8 is DR. AMINA VEY — a woman in her forties with LIGHT BROWN SKIN and DARK CURLY HAIR in a LOOSE MESSY BUN with strands escaping. Layered SLATE-BLUE technical workwear with a high draped cowl collar, a LEATHER STRAP across the chest, a WIDE OXBLOOD-RUST SASH, heavy laced BOOTS, small CLEAR GLASS-AND-CERAMIC SAMPLE PODS riding on thin dark articulated metal armatures off her harness, and an open field notebook. She is the ONLY person here in blue. She wears NO black column, NO rectangular panels, NO braided crown and NO drop earrings.
@Image4 and @Image5 are TOMAS GREY — a MAN in his thirties, tall, OLIVE-SKINNED, dark CURLY hair and a SHORT DARK BEARD. @Image4 IS THE ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY FOR TOMAS — his face, his collar, his cuffs, his coat and the black ribbon around him — AND IT OVERRIDES EVERY OTHER IMAGE AND EVERY WORD OF DESCRIPTION ON THAT SUBJECT. COPY HIS COSTUME FROM IT EXACTLY: a floor-length BLACK ROBE-COAT with ONE FLAT CREAM-OATMEAL LINEN PANEL down the centre front, TURNED-BACK CREAM CUFFS at both wrists, a TALL SMOOTH CYLINDRICAL CREAM COLLAR wrapped close around his throat with a level top edge — a smooth closed tube, never flared, never a wing, never a scallop, never two upright panels — and THE CLAUSE RIBBON, a long matte black band covered in fine pale engraved script, LOOPING AND SPIRALLING AROUND HIS BODY in large open curves and standing away from him in the air. THERE IS ONLY ONE TOMAS IN THIS FILM.

=== SHOT 1 — 0:00 to 0:06 — MEDIUM, 40mm, SLOW PUSH ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT.

BEATRICE — the woman with the high topknot in the black wrap coat with the oxblood panel — RAISES THE RED OVAL with one hand and turns it in the air until its long axis is square to the seated frozen man. IT STOPS OF ITS OWN ACCORD and hangs there, upright, unsupported. As soon as it is square, THE INSIDE OF THE OVAL IS PLAINLY A DIFFERENT PICTURE FROM THE ROOM AROUND IT — cold and blue-white where the carriage is warm and amber. CLOSE TO THE LENS AND OUT OF FOCUS AT ONE EDGE, AMINA'S GLASS SAMPLE PODS ride past on their armatures. THE MOVE: the camera pushes in slowly and continuously and is still advancing at the cut.

CUT at 0:06.

=== SHOT 2 — 0:06 to 0:17 — INSERT SQUARE THROUGH THE OVAL, 65mm, ABSOLUTELY LOCKED, ONE UNBROKEN TAKE ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT (all off screen, over the picture):
AMINA (off screen): "That's the wrong direction."
BEATRICE (off screen): "Say more."
AMINA (off screen): "Cold enters a body. It doesn't leave one. There is no ecology in which that happens."

The camera is square-on to the oval, close enough that the RED RIM RUNS AROUND THE EDGE OF THE FRAME with the warm walnut carriage and an amber lamp visible OUTSIDE it at the corners. THE CAMERA DOES NOT MOVE AT ALL AND THERE IS NO CUT ANYWHERE INSIDE THIS SHOT.

SEEN THROUGH THE OVAL — EXACTLY @Image2: KELL, ALIVE, EARLIER THIS MORNING. The same man in the same PALE GREY-OATMEAL OVERCOAT at the same window table, lit COLD, FLAT AND BLUE-WHITE from above. HIS EYES ARE OPEN AND ON HIS WORK. HIS SKIN IS A LIVING WARM COLOUR, with colour in his lips and cheeks. AT THE START OF THE SHOT HIS COAT, HIS HANDS AND THE CLOTH ARE CLEAN AND DRY. He holds a PEN in his right hand and IS WRITING on a cream form, steadily, like a man finishing a form before a deadline he has already calculated. He is calm and busy — NOT shivering, NOT distressed, NOT gasping and NOT struggling.

AND ACROSS THE WHOLE ELEVEN SECONDS, IN COMPLETE SILENCE, WHITE FROST GROWS OUTWARD FROM THE CENTRE OF HIS CHEST — starting as a small star at his sternum and advancing in fine crystal needles ACROSS HIS PALE COAT, then ONTO THE WHITE TABLECLOTH, then ACROSS THE BACKS OF HIS OWN WRITING HANDS, radiating AWAY from him in every direction at once. HE KEEPS WRITING THROUGH ALL OF IT, EYES OPEN, AND NEVER LOOKS AT IT. AT THE END OF THE SHOT HE IS STILL ALIVE AND STILL WRITING, his hands rimed white. That is the tragedy: he budgeted.
SOUND INSIDE THE FIELD: NOTHING AT ALL — no chair, no paper, no pen, no breath. Only Amina's and Beatrice's voices from the room, and the carriage hum outside the field.
Amina says her lines as a correct professional stating a correct professional fact — an anomaly in her data, NOT a revelation.

CUT at 0:17.

=== SHOT 3 — 0:17 to 0:23 — CLOSE-UP, 85mm, SLOW PUSH — HE IS LARGE IN THE FRAME ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT.

A LARGE FRONT-ON CLOSE-UP: TOMAS GREY steps in through the vestibule door from the pier and stops. HIS HEAD AND SHOULDERS FILL THE FRAME. THE TALL SMOOTH CREAM TUBE COLLAR IS PLAINLY VISIBLE ACROSS THE BOTTOM OF THE FRAME and THE ENGRAVED BLACK RIBBON LOOPS THROUGH THE FRAME BESIDE HIS HEAD. COLD blue-white spill from the open vestibule BEHIND him, warm amber in front.
HE HAS COME IN FROM A PLATFORM AT MINUS FOURTEEN AND THE AIR DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF HIS FACE AND MOUTH IS COMPLETELY CLEAR AND TRANSPARENT. The walnut behind him stays crisp right up to his lips. He does not stamp his feet, rub his hands or remark on the cold, because he has not noticed it. Nobody looks at this. He looks off screen at the reconstruction. THE MOVE: a slow continuous push, still advancing at the cut.

CUT at 0:23.

=== SHOT 4 — 0:23 to 0:30 — MEDIUM TWO-SHOT, 50mm, SLOW PUSH ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
TOMAS: "He was not chilled. He was withdrawn from."
BEATRICE: "By what?"
TOMAS: "By something with an account."

BEATRICE AND TOMAS STAND SIDE BY SIDE, BOTH AT FRAME LEFT AND BOTH TURNED TO FACE TOWARD FRAME RIGHT, both looking at the red oval which hangs at frame right with the cold blue-white picture inside it. NEITHER OF THEM TURNS TOWARD THE OTHER AND NEITHER LOOKS AT THE OTHER. Both faces are split: WARM AMBER from the room on one side, COLD BLUE-WHITE from inside the oval on the other. The red stays inside its rim and falls on neither of them. THE MOVE: a slow continuous push in, still advancing at the cut.
HE THROWS THE LAST LINE AWAY COMPLETELY — an account is simply the most accurate available word. NOBODY REACTS TO IT. END on the two of them still watching the oval.

SOUND: a low continuous carriage hum throughout. Small precise mechanical clicks from Amina's pod armatures, unsynchronised. The vestibule door closing on the wind. TOTAL SILENCE from inside the reconstruction. NO music, no score, no swells, no drone and no stingers at any point. ALL BACKGROUND VOICES ARE LOW AND COMPLETELY INDISTINCT AND NO WORD IN THEM CAN BE MADE OUT; only the named lines in this film are intelligible.

Pronounce these words exactly and clearly: DIRECTION, ECOLOGY, CHILLED, WITHDRAWN, ACCOUNT.

PALETTE: evidence red #C7332B, rime white #E9F1F4, carriage amber #B8801F, pier blue #8FA3B0.

PHYSICS: frost grows outward from a body and never inward from a window, an edge or a frame. The oval never glows and emits no light. Nothing glows anywhere. No machinery, no gears, no runes, no magical light, no lens flare, no particles, no smoke, no digital element, no screens, no interface, no signage, no ornament, and no Victorian, Edwardian, medieval or steampunk detail.
